title: Game pack
note: video-game soundtracks sequenced for General MIDI synthesizers: doubled lines, echo copies and chiptune arpeggios, turned into one pianist's part and a drummer's

entries.title: Stage 1
entries.note: Two square-wave arpeggio channels at nineteen notes a second, faded in and out by channel volume.

entries.title: Streets of Rage 2, Level 1
entries.note: Fourteen parts: every line doubled on two or three instruments, and a delayed copy for echo.

entries.title: Stage 1, another sequence
entries.note: Ten parts, every note at full velocity.

entries.title: Character Select
entries.note: Eight parts and a layered double kick, every note at full velocity.
